meta.title: Task Butler
meta.description: An AI work secretary for tasks, sessions and self-evolution: the daily work log, morning brief and retrospective read the real task results and DSH session content and produce concrete findings and next steps instead of status counts; the Today page keeps only three blocks (today's brief / needs you / in progress) with one-line quick capture; the queue auto-claims and runs tasks under a global concurrency limit, and priority affects queue insertion; the 08:30 morning brief offers one-click suggestions and a scheduled work log follows; new DSH workspace sessions fold in; scheduled retrospectives turn failures and your corrections into reusable lessons and DSH skills; webhook notifications included.
